# TAAS® Design Challenge

> TAAS® offers design decision support before the build, spend or commitment. The Design Challenge transforms a space in 10 days for a fixed execution budget of ₹1,45,000 in Mumbai, India.

## Offer
- Execution budget: ₹1,45,000 (fixed scope)
- Design + direction: ₹0 for the first 5 clients, then ₹25,000
- No booking fee
- Duration: 10 days from start of work
- Payment: ₹72,500 at start, ₹43,500 on day 5, ₹29,000 on day 9

## Included
Home makeover, lighting, wall painting, curtains, rugs, floor decor.

## Not included
Civil work, toilets, plumbing, major electrical.

## Who it is for
Renters, rental owners, bachelors, PG residents, renovating owners, cafés and commercial spaces.
